## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools

**Date:** 2026-06-26  
**Link:** [OpenAI — Previewing GPT-5.6 Sol](https://openai.com/index/previewing-gpt-5-6-sol/)  
**Summary:** OpenAI previewed GPT-5.6 Sol, describing it as a next-generation flagship model with stronger coding, science, and cybersecurity capabilities. A related safety hub page says GPT-5.6 is a three-model family: Sol, Terra, and Luna.  
**Why it matters:** This is the only confirmed frontier-model signal in the window. The three-tier family suggests OpenAI is packaging the release across capability, cost, and latency bands rather than shipping a single model.

**Date:** 2026-06-26  
**Link:** [OpenAI Deployment Safety Hub — GPT-5.6 Preview System Card](https://deploymentsafety.openai.com/gpt-5-6-preview)  
**Summary:** OpenAI published safety material for the GPT-5.6 preview, positioning the launch around expanded safeguards and deployment controls.  
**Why it matters:** The safety card is relevant for enterprise and government buyers assessing whether GPT-5.6 can move into controlled production use.

## 2. FOSS / Open-Weight LMs & Tools

**Date:** 2026-06-26  
**Link:** [Alibaba Cloud — ApsaraDB RDS Debuts RDSHermes](https://www.alibabacloud.com/blog/apsaradb-rds-debuts-rdshermes-empowering-database-ai-agents-to-evolve-autonomously_603310)  
**Summary:** Alibaba Cloud introduced RDSHermes, a database-native AI agent service for ApsaraDB RDS built around the open-source Hermes Agent framework. It emphasizes agent memory, self-evolving skills, access controls, audit logs, monitoring, and observability.  
**Why it matters:** This is a concrete move toward database-resident agents with enterprise controls, not just chatbot-style database assistance.
